says: The records: four decisions, 0099, 0105, 0255 and 0582, have a title with an unquoted colon and space, so their frontmatter is not valid YAML, and @kalfa/records' status check reports each as a status finding that no status edit clears. No cleanup slice of the rules and records build lists quoting them, so slice 9's first check on main would not print nothing.
proof: The yaml package (the catalog's 2.9.1) refuses the frontmatter of each with 'Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings at line 3, column 8'; node kalfa/records/src/bin.ts check status on the branch of https://github.com/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/pull/1634 lists the four among its findings.
cost: Slice 9 cannot turn the check on until the four titles are quoted, and a decision written later with the same title shape fails pnpm lint once it is on.
